metadata.title: The semicontinuity of dimensions of measures
metadata.abstract: In this paper, we consider certain uniformity conditions on the radii of balls. Under these conditions, we study the semicontinuity of the Hausdorff dimension of measures with respect to measured Gromov--Hausdorff convergence and box convergence. We also examine the semicontinuity of other dimensions of measures, which are similar to the Hausdorff dimension of measures.

analysis.topic: 度量测度几何、极限与奇异空间
analysis.workSummary: 在球半径的若干一致性条件下，研究测度 Hausdorff 维数相对于测度 Gromov–Hausdorff 收敛及 box 收敛的半连续性，并讨论其他类似测度维数。
analysis.breakthrough: 把测度维数的极限行为与局部尺度的一致控制联系起来。
analysis.limitations: 摘要未列明全部一致性条件及各维数的半连续方向，不能省略条件作统一断言。
analysis.aiEvidence: 作者明确披露使用 ChatGPT-6 Astra 证明引理 4.3 及例 4.4、4.8。
